note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative; every run shows the model as supplied and the result of the replay is supplied, never inferred.

presets.name: baseline-illustrative
presets.description: Fictional shop incident: four events topple in the supplied order and the vase cracks; the take rewinds, the claw lifts event 2 out of the model and the replay runs without it — as supplied, the loss does not occur (the tile before the gap lies down in the empty slot).

presets.name: contrast-or-alternative
presets.description: Substantive alternative: a five-event storeroom chain with two loss objects, an alternative event put forward and one disputed link; event 3 is removed and, as supplied, the loss still occurs in the replay (the tile before the gap reaches the tile after it).

actorLabels.a: Trigger: the same start for both runs
actorLabels.b: Claw: lifts event 3 out of the model

presets.name: long-labels-stress
presets.description: Six events with near-maximum labels and times, two long loss descriptions, two long alternatives, three long link captions, long actor captions, tags and two long callouts.

events.label: Delivery crate left partly blocking the main customer aisle of the shop overnight
Motorised floor-cleaning trolley makes contact with the delivery crate at the corner
Freestanding shelf unit standing directly behind the crate is jolted sideways
Ceramic display stand next to the shelf unit begins to wobble on its uneven feet
Glass display cover resting on the stand slides slowly towards the front edge
Display cover falls against the tall pedestal holding the hand-painted vase
